packageRules.description: Group nerves_system_* bumps. One bump usually triggers a matching nerves_system_br shift, so reviewing them together avoids per-target churn.
Group buildroot-tracked nbpr_X package bumps. These follow Buildroot's pinned package version — the version a user actually gets when source-build runs.

buildroot-package.description: Reads `package/<pkg>/<pkg>.mk` from buildroot/buildroot at the BR_REF pinned in the URL below, base64-decodes the file, and extracts the first `<PKG>_VERSION = <semver>` line. BR_REF is itself tracked by the `nerves-system-br-buildroot-version` datasource — Renovate updates this URL automatically when nerves_system_br/main bumps its NERVES_BR_VERSION pin. Only works where `<PKG>_VERSION` is a literal: packages Buildroot builds from a dated snapshot compute it from other variables (ncurses, for instance, is `$(NCURSES_VERSION_MAJOR)-$(NCURSES_SNAPSHOT_DATE)`), which no regex over the `.mk` can resolve. Such a package needs its own datasource reading whichever variable actually holds the version.

nerves-system-br-buildroot-version.description: Reads nerves_system_br/main's create-build.sh and extracts NERVES_BR_VERSION. Used to keep the BR_REF in this very renovate.json in lockstep with nerves_system_br's pinned Buildroot version. Tracks `main` rather than the latest tag, so it leads pinned releases by some skew — review the resulting PR alongside the nerves_system_* group.

customManagers.description: Workspace @prebuild_systems map → upstream nerves_system_* GitHub releases.
nbpr_jq @version → Buildroot's `JQ_VERSION` line at the pinned BR_REF.

nbpr_dnsmasq @version → Buildroot's `DNSMASQ_VERSION` line. Buildroot ships e.g. `2.91`/`2.92` (two-component); the package's mix.exs `normalise_version/1` pads `@version` to Hex's three-component shape at load time, so a raw bump like `2.92` loads and publishes cleanly with no manual re-pad. semver-coerced versioning makes the comparison work.

nbpr_kmod @version → Buildroot's `KMOD_VERSION` line at the pinned BR_REF. kmod versions upstream as a bare major (e.g. `33`), so the regex allows zero dots; the package's `normalise_version/1` pads to Hex's three-component shape.
nbpr_gpsd @version → Buildroot's `GPSD_VERSION` line at the pinned BR_REF.

nbpr_chrony @version → Buildroot's `CHRONY_VERSION` line at the pinned BR_REF. Buildroot ships two-component versions here (e.g. `4.8`); the package's `normalise_version/1` pads `@version` to Hex's three-component shape at load time.

nbpr_libcap @version → Buildroot's `LIBCAP_VERSION` line at the pinned BR_REF. Buildroot ships two-component versions here (e.g. `2.78`); the package's `normalise_version/1` pads `@version` to Hex's three-component shape at load time.

nbpr_pps_tools @version → Buildroot's `PPS_TOOLS_VERSION` line at the pinned BR_REF. The Hex name underscores what Buildroot hyphenates, so packageName has to be the Buildroot spelling for the registry URL to resolve.

BR_REF in this very renovate.json — points the buildroot-package datasource at the right Buildroot release. Tracks nerves_system_br/main's NERVES_BR_VERSION via the nerves-system-br-buildroot-version custom datasource. Regex only matches digit-dot refs (not `main` or branch names), so it leaves the nerves-system-br-buildroot-version URL alone.
